newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end down on weak HK market.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end down on weak HK market.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index ended sharply down on Monday, the first day after the two-week Lunar New Year break, driven down by heavy losses last week on the Hong Kong stock market, brokers said.
The B share index lost 4.75 points or 3.02 percent to 152.31 points on volume of 12.9 million shares worth HK$69.80 million.
Trading on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has been closed for the past two weeks for the annual holiday.

"Poor performance on the Hong Kong stock exchange last week discouraged B-share investors, who largely stayed on the sidelines on Monday," Xu Yinhui, an analyst with China Guotai Securities Co Ltd, said.
"The wait-and-see attitude is likely to dominate the market in the coming sessions, when several B share firms are expected to release 1996 results," Xu said.
The technical correction helped drag down the B index after its advances in the last two sessions before the holiday, brokers said.
"A steep fall is unlikely unless there is major bad news," a broker said.
Guangdong Provincial Expressway Development Co Ltd, the worst performer, plunged HK$0.76 or 9.42 percent to HK$7.31 on 255,400 shares. Brokers said they saw no reason for the decline.

Zhuhai SEZ Lizhu Pharmaceutical Group Inc, the second biggest loser, dived HK$0.29 or 5.1 percent to HK$5.40 on volume of 221,700 shares. Brokers said the fall was linked to market talk the company's 1996 results could be disappointing.
